issue_request: FHIR-16708 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request from the STU3 ballot asking how to represent quotes in a CQL expression reference; the approved resolution was to add a note explaining the XML quote entity and to add a JSON example.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git-svn commit 9069a302587993bb7e53ac85531a96db7329c904, which added the XML quote-escaping note and JSON example to source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html. The guidance survived later maintenance, but the JSON example's dynamicValue array lacked the required object wrapper.
additional_context: The Using Expressions topic is in current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and source/clinicalreasoning-module.html. Later source updates changed the CQL media type examples to text/cql-identifier, and no discovered Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence reverses the FHIR-16708 guidance.
